name: permission-menu
title: Permission Menu
description: An access level on a sharing row — a ghost trigger reading the level, a menu of levels with one-line descriptions and a check on the current one, an optional destructive Remove access, and a read-only text mode for built-in rows.

meta.whenToUse: Choose or show the access level of one person, team or group on a sharing or membership row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form field choosing a value (Select), or a row's general actions (DropdownMenu or RowActionMenu).
